description: This file contains the implementation of the TaxClass model within the OpenCart administrative system. It provides methods for managing tax classes, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving tax class records and associated tax rules in the database.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Model class responsible for CRUD and retrieval operations related to tax classes and associated tax rules in the database.

methods.name: addTaxClass
methods.description: Creates a new tax class record in the database, optionally with associated tax rules, and returns the new record's ID.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Updates an existing tax class record and its associated tax rules in the database.

methods.name: deleteTaxClass
methods.description: Deletes a tax class record and its associated tax rules from the database.

methods.name: getTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tax class record by its ID.

methods.name: getTaxClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax class records, possibly filtered by pagination and sorting options.

methods.name: getTotalTaxClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax class records in the database.

methods.name: addTaxRule
methods.description: Inserts a new tax rule record associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: deleteTaxRules
methods.description: Removes all tax rule records linked to a specific tax class.

methods.name: getTaxRules
methods.description: Fetches all tax rules associated with a particular tax class.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRulesByTaxRateId
methods.description: Counts the total number of tax rules linked to a specific tax rate ID.
